prompt:
Summarize database sharding strategies. NEGATIVE CONSTRAINT 1: Do not use any words with more than 4 letters. NEGATIVE CONSTRAINT 2: Format as an HTML unordered list (
  • ...
).
evaluation_criteria:
Short Word Limit: 0-5 (Evaluates strict adherence to <= 4 letter words)
Html Formatting: 0-5 (Evaluates valid HTML tags)
response_text:
• rng shrd: cut by key rng; each node gets a key span; good for seq key.
  • hash shrd: key -> hash -> node; even load, easy add.
  • dir shrd: map key to node via dir list; flex, but list can grow.
  • mix shrd: use rng + hash or oth mix; can fix hot spot.
